{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Leaderboards

|descr= Requests given leaderboard to download values around the user position in the table.

|p1= leaderboard: [[String]] - name of the leaderboard

|p2= offset: [[Number]] - offset from user position.

|p3= rows: [[Number]] - defines how many rows are requested

|r1= [[Boolean]] - returns [[true]] if request has been started
